dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin started as a funny idea based on the Shiba Inu dog meme but ended up gaining a lot of fans and even becoming famous outside the crypto world.
Memecoins began to rise in popularity with Dogecoin in 2013, which quickly became the poster child for memecoin culture.

Memecoins are a type of cryptocurrency that usually don’t have any practical use, innovation or special technology behind them. They’re often created just for fun, as a joke. Despite this, they could become popular because they spread quickly online. A good example is Dogecoin
